a2_rule: Amendment A2 (PROPOSED 2026-11-13, awaiting Yixun; fixed before any real-data score). Coarse set COARSE = {(I, k) : circular column distance of k from 0 <= 32}, i.e. k in 480..511 or 0..32 with S = I only (32 columns = 22.5 deg = one C16 step); the accept set is unchanged ({(I, k) : k in {510, 511, 0, 1, 2}}); the arg-max-set definition and the tie tolerance (1e-12) are the registered ones. PASS iff all of: (a) the full aggregate: the arg-max set of Score B is a subset of the accept set and the arg-max set of Score A is a subset of COARSE; (b) every leave-one-category-out aggregate: the same two conditions (an undefined curve fails); (c) the room bootstrap on the same 1000 x n_rooms resample matrix as the registered gate (numpy.random.default_rng(43).integers(0, n_rooms, size=(1000, n_rooms))): a resample passes iff B's arg-max set is a subset of the accept set and A's arg-max set is a subset of COARSE; PASS needs >= 990 passing resamples. Report-only diagnostics (never gating): A at B's full-aggregate arg-max, max A and their difference; the circular column distance between A's and B's full-aggregate arg-maxes; the bootstrap arg-max histograms of A and B; the leave-one-category-out arg-max sets of A and B.

gate_registered.rule: Registered gate (plan_std_aug.md 4.1, frozen). Accept set {(I, k) : k in {510, 511, 0, 1, 2}}. The arg-max set of a curve is {h : curve[h] >= max - 1e-12}; a curve passes iff its arg-max set is a subset of the accept set. PASS iff all of: (1) the full aggregate: Score A and Score B pass; (2) every leave-one-category-out aggregate: A and B pass (an undefined curve fails); (3) the room bootstrap: resample b is row b of numpy.random.default_rng(43).integers(0, n_rooms, size=(1000, n_rooms)) over the selected rooms in inputs order, its curves are the multiplicity-weighted room means (B over its rooms with >= 2 receivers; none -> the resample fails), it passes iff A and B pass; PASS needs >= 990 passing resamples.
